correctness.rationale: From the exact specified old-memory update z+=(M_ab)z, the iid round coupling P00=P11=q and P01=P10=1/2-q gives an exchangeable second-moment 4-vector (X,U,H,V) with transfer T rows [2q,-4q,1/2,2q-1/2],[-q,2q,-1/4,1/4-q],[1/2,0,1/2,0],[q,1-2q,0,q]. Independent symbolic construction gives characteristic z/8(8z³-(40q+4)z²+(36q-4)z+1-6q) and rational X generating function (t-2)^2((6q-1)t-2)/((6q-1)t³+(4-36q)t²+(4+40q)t-8). The documented cubic Schur factors are positive exactly on 0<=q<1/10; at q=1/10 the uncancelled simple t=1 pole gives limit X/x0²=6/19 with other poles ±sqrt20; for q>1/10 the denominator has an uncancelled root t* in (0,1), so Cauchy–Hadamard gives exponential subsequence growth. Independent checker verified T, determinant, F and residue exactly, with spectral samples either side. Stability concerns mean square with fixed zero initial memories, not almost sure.
residual_risks: At critical q, entire moment state may not converge, but only position X limit is claimed.
No statement for unequal Hessians, arbitrary initial shifts, time-correlated coins or other step sizes.

value.rationale: Within-worker-marginal budget and number of transmitted scalars are fixed, yet changing only cross-worker coupling reverses mean-square stability and produces an exact nonzero critical error. This is a meaningful structural limitation of independent-compression intuition; the exact 1/10 boundary and 6/19 floor are usable reproducible benchmarks, not arbitrary parameter slices.
residual_risks: Model is deliberately scalar with fixed learning rates and iid rounds, not a general training guarantee.

limitations: No claim of arbitrary network/stochastic/finite-data stability; exact coupled scalar benchmark only.
General compressor analyses may have unsearched specialized boundary results.
